shared_elements: frontal human face carved in stone
large staring eyes rendered as raised/incised ovals
broad flat nose and simple mouth
head set atop a tapering monolithic block or column
hair or headdress mass framing the face
justification: Both are monolithic grey stone sculptures dominated by a frontal, schematic human face with heavy brows, oval eyes and a broad flat nose sitting atop a tapering columnar mass, which is the most specific correspondence. They differ substantially in scale of treatment and technique: A is a full standing figure whose body is covered in shallow incised/low-relief ornament (discs, bands, curvilinear motifs) with a small flat-faced head under a patterned headdress, while B is a purely volumetric, undecorated head with deeply modelled, rounded features and no surface pattern at all.
